## Project Implementation

We used Codex to help prepare the firmware, FPGA implementation, documentation, and automated verification tools. Generated code still needs engineering review and hardware testing. Passing software tests does not establish that the physical system will levitate an object.

## Website

Codex helped build this Quarto website and summarize the existing project notes. It also revised the layout using the E155 course and project websites as references, and revised the writing using our E155 portfolios as style references.

The earlier version included a generated SVG concept illustration and custom interactive components. The current version uses a basic Quarto layout with text, tables, and links.

## Reviewing the Work

The test results on this website come from the dated verification record. Hardware measurements, photographs, and a demonstration video still need to be added. We are responsible for reviewing the generated work, reproducing the builds and tests, and checking the hardware before use.
